name: 30 April beach
kicker: Silt sand beside the seafood market
summary: Walk about 50 m from chợ Hàng Dương onto bãi 30 tháng 4 and sit on the shore after you eat. A 2019 story calls the beach still rough. Dân trí calls the sand black from silt. A beach ticket, a lifeguard hour, and a swim rule were not printed. Check on arrival. Go late, when the market is cooking.
dotReason: The evening half of a night in the beach town.
getThere: A walk of about 50 m from Hàng Dương if you are already in the beach town.
heroCaption: Tidal sand and casuarina at bãi 30 tháng 4

notice.title: No swim rule was printed
notice.body: A lifeguard hour and a swim flag were not on the pages that describe this shore. Check on arrival before you go in the water.

body: Bãi 30 tháng 4 sits beside Hàng Dương, on đường Thạnh Thới, in the old xã Long Hòa, now xã Cần Giờ. A 2019 story puts the sand about 50 m from the market and says people sit on the shore after eating. The same story calls the beach still rough. Dân trí calls the Cần Giờ sand black from silt.

Go after the forest gate closes, when the market is cooking. One seller in that 2019 story said she sold from about 7:00 until about 21:00. That clock is one stall. A tide table was not printed. If you slept in town, the same shore is the morning walk.
A beach ticket was not printed. Check on arrival. A chair hire from 2019 is not a current fee.

figures.caption: The shore at dawn, with casuarina and low roofs along the tree line
figures.alt: Dawn light on the water and casuarina at the Can Gio shore

gettingThere: From the beach town, walk from chợ Hàng Dương. The 2019 story puts the sand about 50 m from the market.

From Ho Chi Minh City, Visit HCMC prints about 1 hour 30 minutes and about 50 km to the ferry road. Tuổi Trẻ prints about 2 hours. The beach is in the town after that crossing. Minutes from Vàm Sát to the sand were not printed. Check on arrival.

legs.heading: From the beach town
legs.body: Walk from Hàng Dương on đường Thạnh Thới. About 50 m, in the 2019 market story.

legs.heading: From Ho Chi Minh City
legs.body: The Bình Khánh ferry, then the town. About 1 hour 30 minutes and about 50 km on Visit HCMC, or about 2 hours in Tuổi Trẻ.

closed: A lifeguard hour and a swim rule are check on arrival.
